teaching.calls_ok: Meaning: deep answers that came back non-empty, out of 5 in a row in one process. Threshold: 5 of 5, because every ARAIL consumer makes more than one deep call per process and call 2 is where every known broken build fails. Out of range: 1 of 5 means the runtime answers once per process; a lab using it gets one deep answer per restart and silent fall-backs after. Failure lives in: the QueueLLM binary (mlx-native Qwen2 prefill, rms_norm weight of 1 element), not in ARAIL.
teaching.ok_seconds: Meaning: wall time of the one call that answered (prefill plus up to 384 tokens; 38 to 44 words here). Threshold: none for this check; /deep would need a median of at most 120 s. Out of range: not decidable, because only one call per build answered. Failure lives in: not applicable.
teaching.failed_seconds: Meaning: time until a failing call raised. Threshold: none. Out of range: 0.00 to 0.02 s means it failed at the first prefill step, before any decoding, for 33 and for 1,933 prompt tokens, and even when it repeated call 1 exactly. Failure lives in: state the runtime carries from call 1 to call 2 inside one process (QueueLLM).
teaching.prompt_tokens: Meaning: prompt length after ARAIL's chat wrap, counted by the model's tokenizer. Threshold: short about 33; long about 1,933, the size of a chat turn with lab context. Out of range: not applicable. Failure lives in: not applicable.
teaching.load_s: Meaning: weights load plus runtime start. Threshold: none here (the shipped probe allows 300 s). Out of range: not applicable. Failure lives in: not applicable.
teaching.preamble_downloadComponent: Meaning: count of the Metal toolchain error marker in a built binary. Threshold: 0, because a build made while the toolchain is down exits 0 and then fails at runtime. Out of range: above 0 means throw the build away unprobed. Failure lives in: the Metal toolchain at build time.
teaching.build_wall: Meaning: time for the offline release build of queuellm-api from a clean scratch target. Threshold: the vision's 3-hour box for build plus probe. Out of range: not applicable. Failure lives in: not applicable.
